why: The collapsed row's honest edge. The group's lines all run 3 days, so the row MAY show days — but the group total of 100.00 over 3 days is 33.33 per day, and 3 × 33.33 is 99.99. The total stays 100.00 (it is the authoritative number) and `exact` is false with `collapsed_price_not_exact`, so a PDF or a screen can decide whether to print a breakdown that does not add up or fall back to `1 × total`. Silently printing 33.33 × 3 = 100.00 is the bug this case exists to make impossible.
